author: Polar_Express
body:
Here is a map I would like to submit for Consideration / thoughts called Plague.

The map offers unique gameplay and places the Infected vs the  Diseased.

The map builds of of Gold ingots as a player kill reward and apples as food. Spawners at each monument give gold ingots as well.

Pics: http://imgur.com/a/qi2kZ

DL: https://www.dropbox.com/s/oiozr34vtht0456/Plague.zip?dl=0
